instrumentPicker.title: What are you practicing on?

welcome.title: Yames
welcome.tagline: A metronome built for real practice. Hands stay on the instrument.

soundLook.title: Sound & look
soundLook.subtitle: Hover a card to hear the click or see the theme. Pick what you like.

handsFree.title: Hands stay on the instrument

keyboard.title: Keyboard
keyboard.hint: Every key is remappable in Settings → Hotkeys.

midi.title: MIDI footswitch
midi.none: Plug one in any time — Yames will offer to map it.
midi.listening: Press the pedal you want for Play/Stop.

gamepad.title: Gamepad
gamepad.none: Connect a controller any time — press a button and Yames will see it.
gamepad.listening: Press the button you want for Play/Stop.

coach.title: Practice coach
coach.what1: The coach listens through your audio input and scores how your timing sits against the click.
coach.what2: After each run it writes a short report — and, with a brain downloaded, explains what to work on next.
coach.privacy: Everything runs on this machine. Your audio never leaves it, and release builds never record it.

timing.title: Timing feedback only
timing.desc: No download. You still get the live dots, the timing score and your session history.

standard.title: Standard brain
standard.desc: Qwen3 4B · ~2.5 GB download · ~4 GB RAM while running. Runs on the CPU if you have no GPU.

studio.title: Studio brain
studio.desc: Qwen3 8B · ~5 GB download · ~8 GB RAM. Richer feedback and practice plans.

coach.reasonNoLlm: This build can't run a model, so timing feedback is the honest choice here.

coach.reasonInstalled: Already downloaded on this machine — nothing to fetch.

tryListening.label: Try the listening feature anyway
tryListening.hint: Two short steps: pick your input, play eight beats, and see your timing.

audioInput.title: Set up your input
audioInput.subtitle: Yames listens through this to score your timing. Play something and watch the meter move.

guidance.electric-guitar: Plug into an interface, or play in front of the laptop mic — the mic works, an interface is better.
guidance.acoustic-guitar: Play towards the laptop mic, or use a pickup through an interface. Both work.
guidance.bass: An interface is best for bass — laptop mics lose the low end, though they still hear the attack.
guidance.drums: Any mic in the room will do. Put it where it hears the whole kit, not one drum.
guidance.piano: A mic near the instrument is enough. A digital piano can go straight into an interface.
guidance.other: An interface is better, but the laptop mic works — just play close to it.

audioInput.waiting: Play something — the meter needs a second of signal.
audioInput.heard: Got it. Yames can hear you.
audioInput.skip: Skip, I'll set this up later

hearItWork.title: Hear it work
hearItWork.subtitle: Four beats to get ready, then play along for eight. Nothing is invented — you see exactly what was heard.
hearItWork.ready: Play along with the click. One note on every beat is plenty.
hearItWork.nothing: Didn't hear anything — check the input level.

ready.title: You're ready
ready.subtitle: Change anything here, or later in Settings.

help.title: Help
help.reportDone: Diagnostics saved. Attach this file to your report:
help.reportError: Could not write the diagnostics file.
help.alwaysOnTopNote: Yames stays above other windows. Change that in Settings → General.

desc.startBpm: The tempo you begin practicing at. Start slow and build up.
desc.targetBpm: The goal tempo you're working toward.
desc.increment: BPM added each up-step. Bigger number = faster ramp.
desc.decrement: BPM subtracted each down-step (zigzag only). Smaller than increment to crawl forward.
desc.beats: Clicks per cell. Beat 1 is always accented so you can hear the pattern.
desc.repeat: How many cells per column — the number of times you repeat at each tempo before moving on.
desc.mode: Linear goes straight up. Zigzag alternates. Adaptive adjusts based on your accuracy.
desc.cyclic: Goes up to target then back down to start in the same increments (round-trip).
desc.aggressiveness: How quickly the tempo changes. Conservative waits longer, Aggressive pushes faster.
desc.countdown: 4-beat countdown before the drill starts. Helps you lock into the tempo.
